reason: The hypothesis combines the well-known strategy of oxide dispersion strengthening (ODS) with yttrium (from P8, P31, P45) and the concept of grain boundaries as defect sinks (from P6, P7, P9, P23) and applies it to a refractory high-entropy alloy (RHEA) for plasma-facing applications. While ODS-W is established, transferring this specific intervention (Y doping to form nano-oxides) to a RHEA system is a straightforward extension that does not synthesize disparate findings or propose a novel mechanism; it essentially proposes what P8 and similar works already suggest as a beneficial approach, merely changing the base material.
copied_elements: Yttrium-rich oxide dispersions as defect sinks (P8, P31, P45)
Grain boundaries as defect sinks (P6, P7, P9, P23)
